lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic crystal Ba₁₂Li₂Se₁₀ (reduced formula Ba₆LiSe₅) adopts space group Amm2 (No. 38) with 24 atoms in the unit cell across 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ba centers with 8- and 9-coordinate Se environments, including a body-centered-cubic-like 8-neighbor arrangement, while Li centers are 6-coordinate to Se and Se centers are 4- or 5-coordinate, predominantly 5-coordinate. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between 9-vertex Ba and 5-vertex Se polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between 5-vertex Se polyhedra.
